name: ideation
description: One entry point, at the right depth. /ideation picks just do it, short plan, an evidence-gated interview stress-tested by adversarial plan critics, or a map for foggy multi-session work, and opens with a no-files 'should we?' conversation when the question is whether to build at all. Plans are data you answer on a page or in the terminal; a terminal approval hands the run contract to a deterministic workflow engine. Watched runs teach the next interview.
